_about: EVERY rule value lives here. The engine reads this file; data/rules.json (what the page reads) is generated from it. There is ONE rule set: Gap + Guard (ops.gap_guard). Probabilities are 0-1, prices are American integers, times are Eastern.

ops._about: How the engine runs. None of these change which bets qualify. Markets other than shots are read and logged for the team (shadow log) only; picks are shots lines 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5 (ops.gap_guard).

safety_pause._about: Automatic safeguard, not a rule about what qualifies: when the Record's graded singles are down this many units, no NEW picks are added (shown picks are still looked after) until a person reviews.
safety_pause.text: New picks are stopped: the Record is down 10 units or more.
safety_pause.sub: The team has to review before picks resume. Picks already shown are unaffected.

gap_guard._about: THE live rule: Gap + Guard (TEAM.md section 4). Every pick on the page and in the Record comes from this block and nothing else. Offsets are FROZEN (refit once from the 2025-26 Hard Rock shots lines at -45 min, model from prior games only; do not change without the Data Scientist naming the sample and the Sharp logging it in section 8). All EV% = fair_prob x Hard Rock decimal payout - 1; every threshold is inclusive.

watch.label: Points
watch.note: Behind the scenes (Matt 2026-10-28, replaces the saves track): player points through the exact Gap + Guard maths of shots. Research only: data/paper_watch/points/, shown on the page's Behind the scenes tab, never the Record, Discord or status.json. Lines: any (0.5 is ~94% of Hard Rock's points lines). Model offset 0 (uncalibrated for the 2026-27 season, 20% weight, can only veto). Saves stopped 2026-10-28; its log stays in data/paper_watch/saves/.
